_header.purpose: Scoring key for SpectraCQ-Core: for each of the 560 Core items, its declared answer column and the gold value set of that column. paper/baseline/score_core.py scores against it; the Core and contract-exact scores in the paper use this key.
_header.released_query: gold_values are the distinct values of answer_column over the released gold rows (gold/<WG>_gold.json), canonicalised by bench_common.canon.
_header.scope_repaired_query: 7 reference queries restrict a property, directly in a WHERE clause, to a literal list of two or more values that the question does not all state. repaired_cypher is the same query with that restriction replaced by true; gold_values are its values for answer_column. gold_values_released_query keeps the released query values; they differ for 6 of the 7. score_core.py --gold released scores on them.
_header.scorer_normalisation: score.norm is applied to both gold and predicted values before comparison.

repaired_cypher: MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.214'}) WHERE true RETURN t.tdocNumber, t.title, t.status, t.type ORDER BY t.tdocNumber ASC LIMIT 1

gold_values: Modulation order, target code rate, redundancy version and transport block size determination
Physical downlink shared channel related procedures
UE procedure for receiving the physical downlink shared channel

repaired_cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE true RETURN sp.specNumber, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC
MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE true RETURN sp.specNumber, count(DISTINCT agr) AS agrCount ORDER BY agrCount DESC

MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE true WITH agr, collect(DISTINCT sp.specNumber) AS specs WHERE size(specs) > 1 MATCH (agr)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN agr.resolutionId, specs, m.meetingNumber ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC, agr.resolutionId LIMIT 10

MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE true WITH sp.specNumber AS ts, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH (sec:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp2:Spec {specNumber: ts}) RETURN ts, crCount, count(sec) AS sectionCount ORDER BY crCount DESC
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE true MATCH (cr)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(co:Company) RETURN co.companyName, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 15

MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE true WITH sp.specNumber AS ts, count(cr) AS crCnt OPTIONAL MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr2:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp2:Spec) WHERE sp2.specNumber = ts RETURN ts, crCnt, count(DISTINCT agr) AS agrCnt ORDER BY crCnt DESC
